# DevDesigns Full Technical Documentation Manifest

## Brand Identification
- **Brand Name**: DevDesigns
- **Legal Entity**: DevDesigns Enterprise Digital Infrastructure & Design
- **Website**: https://devdesigns.net
- **Primary Category**: Enterprise Digital Agency, SaaS Engineering & Cloud Infrastructure

## Comprehensive Capabilities Matrix

### 1. UI/UX Design System Engineering
- High-fidelity wireframing and prototyping (Figma, Framer)
- Design system creation with React component tokens
- Micro-interaction design using Framer Motion
- Responsive layout architecture (Desktop, Tablet, Mobile)
- Accessibility compliance (WCAG 2.1 AA)

### 2. Full-Stack Web & Mobile App Development
- **Frontend Frameworks**: Next.js 15+, React 19, TypeScript
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS v4, CSS Modules, Glassmorphism design system
- **Backend Infrastructure**: Node.js, Express, Next.js Server Actions, REST APIs, GraphQL
- **Database Systems**: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis caching layers
- **State Management**: React Hooks, Context API, Zustand
- **Deployment & CI/CD**: Vercel, Docker containers, AWS ECS/S3, GitHub Actions

### 3. Microsoft PowerApps & Enterprise Automation
- Canvas Apps (Pixel-perfect mobile & desktop workflows)
- Model-Driven Apps (Dataverse-backed enterprise portals)
- Power Automate (RPA & multi-service API flow triggers)
- Microsoft Dataverse (RBAC, security auditing, relational database)
- AI Builder & Custom REST API Connectors for Next.js

### 4. Managed Cloud Infrastructure & Hosting
- 99.9% Uptime Service Level Agreement (SLA)
- Anycast DNS & Edge Network routing
- Automated SSL/TLS encryption certificate renewal
- Web Application Firewall (WAF) & DDoS mitigation
- Real-time telemetry, error tracking, and uptime monitoring

### 4. Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) & Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)
- Structured Data (Schema.org JSON-LD): Corporation, WebSite, Service, FAQPage, ItemList, BreadcrumbList
- AI Crawler Directives (robots.txt): Explicit access permissions for GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot, Anthropic-ai, Google-Extended, Bytespider, Applebot-Extended
- LLM Text Standard: `/llms.txt` and `/llms-full.txt` manifests
- Semantic HTML5 hierarchy for direct factual extraction by Perplexity, SearchGPT, Gemini, and Claude

## Pricing Structure Overview
- **Starter Package**: Ideal for early-stage MVPs, single-page platforms, and brand launches.
- **Enterprise Scale Package**: Custom architectural design, multi-region database replication, dedicated 24/7 DevOps support, and bespoke SLA guarantees.
- **Custom Consultation**: Instant custom proposals available via https://devdesigns.net/contact.
